decisions.reason: The assembled-order availability check is already represented by the source Requirement and does not change the selected USB-C connector or its existing sourceability constraint.
The source requests a general component-availability check but does not change any battery-protection mode, threshold, or safety behavior.
Component availability for an assembled order does not alter the board dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, connector placement, or clearance constraints.
The source provides no availability result or design decision changing the SK6812 charge-status indicator, its GPIO, or the separate-LED rule.
The general availability inquiry does not change the battery connector family, pitch, pinout, mounting style, or placement; no unavailable component is identified.
The assembled-order component check does not change the boost converter's GPIO control, pull-down, powered loads, or operating mode.
The source does not report that either interboard connector is unavailable or change the connector architecture, types, signals, or pinouts.
Assembly is discussed in the surrounding ordering context, but the source Event only adds a component-availability check and leaves the eight-layer stack unchanged.
The component-availability inquiry does not affect I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
